title: Yellow Yuzu Glazed Russian Duck Skewers
description: A show-stopping Russian dish featuring yuzu-cured duck, served on a cedar plank with a sweet and tangy yellow yuzu glaze, this recipe is a perfect combination of flavors and presentation, it is also buddhist-temple-friendly as it does not include any forbidden ingredients
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together yuzu juice, honey, soy sauce, garlic, and ginger to make the glaze.
Add the duck pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the glaze.
Thread the duck pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the cedar planks and brush with the remaining glaze.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, or until the duck is cooked through.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with unwaxed lemon wedges.
